# each case: setxkbmap -rules evdev -model pc105 -layout L [-option O]; then tools/xkb-mutation-probe.c
# case set = every case of xorg-change-keyboard-mapping.txt (same names, layouts, options, requests,
# '## +' follow-ups sent in order); its '!' edge requests on layout=gb follow, with the keysyms used
# probe output lines (see the probe header for the full grammar):
#   > ckm:FIRST:KPK:COUNT:SYMS   raw ChangeKeyboardMapping sent by the actor (syms hex; nsyms = syms listed)
#   = ok | = error=CODE value=V request result
#   e xkb NAME k=v... raw=HEX    XKB event on the XKB listener (XkbSelectEvents all, core kbd), arrival order;
#                                MapNotify fields: types/syms/acts/beh/expl/modmap/vmodmap = first+count
#                                raw = the 32 wire bytes; seq (bytes 2-3) and time (4-7) differ run to run
#   e xkbl ...                   core event on the XKB listener, interleaved in arrival order
#   e core ...                   core event on a separate non-XKB connection
#   - KC <key> / + KC <key>      XkbGetMap(full=all, keys 8..255) before/after the request, differing keys only;
#       <key> = kt=<type index per group 1..4> gi=<groupInfo> w=<width> syms=<width*groups hex>
#               acts=<8 raw bytes per action, '-' none> beh=<type:data> expl=<explicit> mm=<modmap> vmm=<vmodmap>
#   -type/+type N, -vmods/+vmods, ntypes, repeat KC A->B, enabledControls   other XkbGetMap/GetControls changes
#   coremodmap kpm=K 0:... 7:...  core GetModifierMapping after the request
#   > total                      XkbGetMap delta from before the first request to after the last
